h15.text: The HOPE Kentucky Scholars Program covers 100% of tuition and fees – including textbooks – for eligible, traditional first-year and transfer students who are Kentucky residents and graduate from a Kentucky public, private, or home school. As long as the student maintains satisfactory academic progress at Bellarmine, stays enrolled full-time, files the FAFSA each year by April 1, and remains eligible for federal Pell grants and Kentucky state aid (CAP and KTG), the funding is renewable for eight semesters. The program’s funding is applied to any remaining costs for a student after all other institutional, state, and federal funds have been applied (loans and work-study are not included in the calculation).
